redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses distinct material facts (revenue growth, customer acquisition, logistics investment, retail format launch, own-brand expansion, segment performance, liquidity, cost savings program, retail expansion, new brand launch). No substantial overlap exists.

key_information_units.information: Net revenue increased by 11.3% to SEK 3,962.6 million in 2025, driven primarily by the Nordics segment (growing 12.0% to SEK 3,699.8 million, representing 93.4% of group revenue), with Norway surpassing SEK 1 billion in annual sales.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures section (page 6) and Management Report (page 63) detail revenue growth, segment breakdown, and Norway's milestone.

key_information_units.information: Over 350,000 new customers were acquired in Q4 2025 alone.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO Statement (page 7) explicitly highlights Q4 new customer acquisition as a key growth metric.

key_information_units.information: A new SEK 500 million automated warehouse expansion in Vansbro was commissioned in 2025, with ramp-up continuing through the autumn and full operation expected in early 2026, increasing total order capacity to approximately 100,000 orders per day and enabling more efficient, scalable logistics.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Vansbro Warehouse section (pages 24-25) describes the investment, capacity, and strategic impact; Management Report (page 63) notes ramp-up timeline.

key_information_units.information: Lyko launched its first Fab Store concept in Täby Centrum, Stockholm, in October 2025, a 500 sqm store combining inspiration, community, and the full product range.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Events section (page 47) and CEO Statement (page 8) detail the Fab Store launch and its strategic significance.

key_information_units.information: The own brands portfolio expanded, including the relaunch of Make Up Store, the launch of Scandinavian Soap Factory in spring 2025, and the introduction of the PLY Skin skincare brand.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Own Brands section (pages 19-20) and CEO Statement (page 8) outline brand acquisitions, relaunches, and strategic role.

key_information_units.information: The Europe segment experienced a 1.3% revenue decline to SEK 130.7 million due to market reorganization, including closure of local offices in the Netherlands and Germany, with future operations centralized from Nordic headquarters.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Nordics & Europe section (page 21) reports segment performance and reorganization details; Management Report (page 65) confirms office closures.

key_information_units.information: Cash flow from operating activities amounted to SEK 527.5 million (compared to SEK 209.7 million in 2024), while net debt stood at SEK 292.5 million (compared to SEK 333.1 million in 2024).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report (page 63) and Financial Statements (page 66) present cash flow and debt figures.

key_information_units.information: A cost savings program was announced in January 2026, targeting annual savings of approximately SEK 100 million (excluding restructuring costs), with SEK 22 million in restructuring costs impacting Q1 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events After the Reporting Period (Management Report, page 65) details the program and financial impact.

key_information_units.information: Lyko's second Fab Store opened in Kalmar on April 25, 2026, continuing the strategic rollout of experience-driven retail concepts.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events After the Reporting Period (Management Report, page 65) notes the Kalmar Fab Store opening.

key_information_units.information: The new own brand Gleeze was launched at the end of January 2026, expanding Lyko's skincare offerings.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events After the Reporting Period (Management Report, page 65) mentions the Gleeze brand launch.
